art_note: The digital all-over print and flat lighting detract from the luxury positioning, lacking depth and sophisticated texture.
desc_en: A refined silhouette that redefines modern tailoring. This blazer features a regular fit with a flat lapel and long sleeves. The design is completed with two functional pockets. Crafted on demand to ensure exclusivity. This piece offers versatility for formal and casual occasions. Each garment is made upon order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta refinada que redefine la sastrería moderna. Este blazer presenta un corte regular con solapa plana y mangas largas. El diseño se completa con dos bolsillos funcionales. Confeccionada bajo demanda para garantizar exclusividad. Esta pieza ofrece versatilidad para ocasiones formales y casuales. Cada prenda se elabora tras su pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
